description: Ingestion (3 per-institution adapters, student submit via upload/paste, admin scheduled fetch, sources CRUD, notices browse, issuer publish stub), Reviewer console API (unresolved queue, confirm/correct, two-annotator benchmark + Cohen's kappa), the idempotent seed script with fixtures, and the evaluation harness CLI with four baselines and two splits. Corresponds to tasks.md T5, T6, T7, T8. Depends on FEAT-002.
steps: adapters/base.py InstitutionAdapter ABC fetch()->list[RawNotice]; three adapters (inst_northgate, inst_riverside, inst_summit) reading seed/fixtures/<inst>_official.json and returning raw notices incl. source_url. Independently replaceable behind the ABC.

api/ingestion.py: POST /api/ingest/submit (multipart file image/pdf OR json {text}) runs extraction->provenance->comparison and returns the classified result; POST /api/ingest/fetch (admin) runs all three adapters synchronously and upserts by content hash (idempotent, no dupes on re-run); GET/POST /api/ingest/sources (admin) CRUD on institution rows.

api/notices.py: list official notices, notice detail (with fields + evidence), candidates for a submission. api/issuer.py: POST /api/issuer/publish (role issuer) creates an official notice attributed to the issuer institution and runs extraction/provenance (clearly a stub, synthetic accounts).

services/kappa.py Cohen's kappa; api/reviewer.py: GET /api/reviewer/queue (unresolved review_cases with edge + both notices), POST /api/reviewer/cases/{id}/resolve {label} (updates edge label, sets status confirmed/corrected, closes case), GET /api/reviewer/benchmark/pairs, POST /api/reviewer/benchmark/annotate {pair_id, annotator, label}, GET /api/reviewer/benchmark/kappa (Cohen's kappa + per-label counts).

seed/seed.py + seed/fixtures/: 3 fictional institutions (Northgate, Riverside, Summit) with ~40 official notices each; ~60 student submissions covering EVERY relationship type (consistent, contradictory, superseded, corrected, extended, cancelled, unresolved) including deliberately ambiguous pairs that must resolve to unresolved and low-lexical-overlap pairs like '22 Sept' vs '15 Sept'. Include gold relationship labels and gold field values for evaluation, benchmark_pair rows with two-annotator benchmark_annotation rows, and demo users for each role (student/reviewer/admin/issuer) with known passwords. Seed MUST be idempotent (guard by natural keys / content hash; re-run adds no duplicates).

eval/baselines.py: chronological (predict by recency), page_change (superseded if text changed), nli (off-the-shelf mapping), prompted_llm (prompt-style mock). eval/harness.py: python -m finalsay.eval.harness [--split temporal|institution] [--model mock|hf] computing per-field extraction F1, relationship precision/recall/F1 (sklearn), false-confirmation rate, unresolved-case rate, Cohen's kappa; temporal holdout split and held-out-institution (Summit) split; prints a readable report for all four baselines; exits 0 on success regardless of metric values.

Tests: test_ingestion.py (fetch idempotent by hash; submit returns classified result; sources CRUD; issuer publish creates official notice), test_reviewer.py (resolve updates edge+closes case; kappa on a known annotation set matches hand-computed value +/-0.001), test_seed.py (re-run stable row counts; every taxonomy label present), test_eval.py (harness runs both splits and returns all metric keys).
acceptance_criteria: Running the seed twice yields identical row counts the second time (idempotent)
Every relationship taxonomy label appears among seeded submissions
POST /api/ingest/fetch adds no duplicate notices on a second call
Reviewer resolve updates the edge label and closes the review_case

python -m finalsay.eval.harness --split temporal and --split institution both exit 0 and print field F1, relationship P/R/F1, false-confirmation rate, unresolved rate, and kappa for all four baselines
pytest test_ingestion.py test_reviewer.py test_seed.py test_eval.py all pass
verification: cd backend && .venv/bin/python -m finalsay.eval.harness --split temporal && .venv/bin/python -m finalsay.eval.harness --split institution
cd backend && .venv/bin/pytest finalsay/tests/test_ingestion.py finalsay/tests/test_reviewer.py finalsay/tests/test_seed.py finalsay/tests/test_eval.py -q
findings: Implemented all of T5-T8. New modules under backend/finalsay/: adapters/{base.py (InstitutionAdapter ABC + RawNotice dataclass + FixtureAdapter + get_adapters()), inst_northgate.py, inst_riverside.py, inst_summit.py} reading seed/fixtures/<slug>_official.json; services/ingestion.py (shared upsert_official [idempotent by content hash], fetch_all, create_submission, publish_official, get_or_create_institution); services/kappa.py (cohen_kappa via sklearn w/ manual fallback + single-class handling, per_label_counts); api/ingestion.py (POST /api/ingest/submit multipart file OR Form text -> extraction->hash->comparison, image w/o OCR engine -> 422 via OcrUnavailable catch; POST /api/ingest/fetch admin idempotent; GET/POST /api/ingest/sources admin CRUD); api/notices.py (GET /api/notices list, /{id} detail w/ fields, /{submission_id}/candidates); api/issuer.py (POST /api/issuer/publish role issuer stub); api/reviewer.py (GET /queue, POST /cases/{id}/resolve -> confirmed if label unchanged else corrected + closes case, GET /benchmark/pairs, POST /benchmark/annotate upsert, GET /benchmark/kappa). All 7 routers wired into main.create_app (app now exposes 12+ mounted routers). Added ~15 Pydantic schemas. seed/dataset.py + seed/seed.py (runnable as python -m finalsay.seed.seed): writes 3 official fixtures (40 each = 120) + gold_submissions.json (65 gold-labeled submissions covering every taxonomy label incl. ambiguous->unresolved and low-overlap 22-vs-15-Sept superseded spotlights), demo users (student/reviewer/admin/issuer @finalsay.demo, passwords <role>123), benchmark_pair rows (14) with two-annotator (reviewer_a/reviewer_b) benchmark_annotation rows (28). Idempotent: guards by slug/email/content-hash/submission-marker; second run yields identical counts (institutions=3,users=4,official=120,submissions=65,benchmark_pairs=14,annotations=28). eval/baselines.py (chronological, page_change, nli, prompted_llm) + eval/harness.py (python -m finalsay.eval.harness [--split temporal|institution] [--model mock|hf]) computes per-field token-set F1 (macro), relationship P/R/F1 via sklearn, false-confirmation rate, unresolved rate, Cohen's kappa; scores finalsay + all 4 baselines; both splits exit 0. Tests added: test_ingestion.py, test_reviewer.py (kappa hand-computed 0.6153846 within 0.001), test_seed.py, test_eval.py. Full suite: 45 passed (20 prior + 25 new). VERIFICATION RUN: seed twice stable; harness --split temporal and --split institution both exit 0 printing all metrics for all 4 baselines. NOTES/DEVIATIONS: (1) submit endpoint uses Form fields (text/institution_id) + File so multipart-or-paste share one handler; image w/o Tesseract -> HTTP 422 (OcrUnavailable) as required. (2) deadline extraction-F1 reports ~0.0 in the harness because the FEAT-002 _DEADLINE_RE matches 'by' inside 'Issued by:' before the real deadline; left FEAT-002 extraction untouched (out of scope) - the harness correctly reports the true (low) metric. (3) No git repo exists yet (per FEAT-001/002 pattern, orchestrator publishes later); no commit made. (4) seed writes fixture JSON files into seed/fixtures/ on every run (deterministic content, so idempotent).
